column1: # Where should STP's auto CNF-effort threshold sit for KLEE's workload?
# STP defaults it to 200k AIG nodes, chosen conservatively on a corpus of
# one-shot SMT-LIB queries. KLEE's stream is different in two ways that both
# matter: thousands of small queries with a tail of enormous ones, and an
# incremental solver holding state across them. Neither is what the default was
# measured against, so the number is worth deriving here rather than inherited.
# medium is the baseline -- what STP did before auto existed. threshold 0 makes
# auto very-low everywhere, which is the other end of the same dial.
# label <TAB> backend <TAB> LD_LIBRARY_PATH for libstp (or -) <TAB> extra klee args
